title: Affiliate compliance: why monitoring is ignored until it breaks (Dustin Howes with Complyy)
summary: Dustin Howes hosts Joe Campanella of Complyy on AI-driven FTC compliance monitoring for affiliate programs. Dustin's own points are short: compliance gets ignored until something breaks, monitoring gets exponentially harder as programs scale, and affiliate managers should automate it rather than do it by hand.

principles.text: Affiliate compliance is neglected until something breaks, so build it in before a problem forces you to.
principles.quote: affiliate compliance is usually ignored until something actually breaks.

principles.text: Compliance monitoring gets exponentially harder as the program grows, so start early rather than waiting for scale.
principles.quote: exponentially harder to monitor as your program gets bigger and bigger. So affiliate managers, it's never a bad time to start thinking about monitoring this to save your program.

principles.text: Don't manually police affiliates; automate the monitoring with tools.
principles.quote: Nobody's got time to be going out there and manually doing this.

principles.text: Affiliate managers should look for tools that make them better at their job.
principles.quote: affiliate nerdout is all about finding the tools that are going to help affiliate managers and program managers be better at their job.
